title: The Loading Added to an Air Ticket Fare Brands Service Charge for a Booking Made Close to Departure
content:
A booking held in an Air Ticket Fare Brands brand that carries an instalment plan and was opened close to the outbound departure carries a loading on its agency service charge. The loading is set by how many days lay between the day the booking was opened and the outbound departure date.

## 1. The loading

| Where | The loading added is |
| --- | --- |
| the booking was opened within 7 days of the outbound departure and the fare brand carries an instalment plan | 25.00 USD |
| the booking was opened within 30 days of the outbound departure but not within 7, and the fare brand carries an instalment plan | 10.00 USD |
| in every other case | no such loading is added |

Both rows require the brand held to carry an instalment plan; a brand that carries none falls to the last row whenever the booking was opened.

## 2. Boundary readings, on hypothetical dates

On a brand carrying an instalment plan, a booking opened exactly 7 days before the outbound departure is within 7 days, so 25.00 USD is added. A booking opened 8 days before it is not within 7 but is within 30, so 10.00 USD is added. A booking opened exactly 30 days before it is within 30, so 10.00 USD is added; one opened 31 days before it falls outside both rows, and no such loading is added.

On a brand carrying no instalment plan, a booking opened 2 days before the outbound departure still falls to the last row.
